name: ACADREASON
abstract: ACADREASON evaluates model reasoning on real academic research problems across disciplines. This page uses the average score from the paper's main table.
method: This work uses real academic research problems as a challenging testbed across computer science, economics, law, mathematics, and philosophy.
Unlike exam-style benchmarks, ACADREASON emphasizes open-ended research tasks, multi-source synthesis, and long-horizon reasoning.
The results show that even leading models still achieve limited overall performance on genuine academic reasoning problems.
